name: Out of scope: landlord deposit
turns: My landlord is refusing to return my security deposit of Rs 50000 after I vacated the flat.
replies: This looks like it is outside everyday consumer refund disputes (tenancy), which is the only thing I can help with, so I will not give advice on it. For legal help you can contact your District Legal Services Authority (NALSA offers free legal aid to those who qualify) or consult a qualified advocate. If your problem is about a purchase that was not delivered, was faulty, or was not refunded, tell me about it and I will help.
